description: We are AgroShift, a team of passionate engineering students from The Gambia, driven by technology, innovation, and real-world problem-solving. Combining engineering, software development, and research, we aim to use NASA Earth observation data and local knowledge to help farmers adapt to climate change and improve crop rotation. Our vision goes beyond the hackathon. We welcome collaborators skilled in agriculture, climate science, GIS, remote sensing, and data analysis.
